'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
****One [[civilian]] is killed and three others are injured in a cross-border attack by [[Hezbollah]] in [[Shtula]], [[Northern District (Israel)|Northern]] [[Israel]]. Israel retaliates with [[airstrike]]s on Hezbollah positions in [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/one-killed-3-wounded-cross-border-hezbollah-attack-northern-israel-2023-10-15/ (Reuters)]
****[[United Nations]] [[peacekeeping]] force [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon|UNIFIL]] says its [[headquarters]] in [[Naqoura]], Lebanon, has been hit by a rocket. [https://www.reuters.com/article/israel-palestinians-lebanon/peacekeeping-force-unifil-says-headquarters-in-south-lebanon-hit-by-a-rocket-idUKC6N37M01C (Reuters)]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****An estimated one million Gazans have been displaced, according to the [[UNRWA|United Nations Palestinian agency]], as aid groups describe the situation in the besieged [[enclave]] as "catastrophic". [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/israel-readies-to-invade-gaza-where-one-million-have-fled-homes/articleshow/104445034.cms?from=mdr (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]
****The [[Palestinian Ministry of Health]] says that about 70 percent of people in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] do not have access to health services, although the [[World Health Organization]] has been able to deliver medical supplies for 2,000 patients. The ministry also says that at least 50 families in the Gaza Strip have had all of their family members killed by Israeli shelling and air strikes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-residents-who-have-lost-family-fear-more-destruction-ground-assault-looms. (Reuters)]
***[[Human Rights Watch]] confirms that Israel has used [[White_phosphorus_munitions|white phosphorus]] in Gaza and [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20231015-ngos-accuse-israel-of-using-white-phosphorus-munitions-in-gaza-%E2%80%93-but-what-are-they (France 24)]
***Israel conducts military operations in [[Ramallah]] in the [[West Bank]], arresting more than 50 people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/14/israel-hamas-war-live-us-moves-second-aircraft-carrier-to-mediterranean (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] kill senior [[Hamas]] commander Billal Al Kedra in an airstrike in [[Khan Yunis]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/top-hamas-commander-behind-israel-infiltration-killed-in-airstrike-4482620 (NDTV)]
*[[Killing of Wadea al-Fayoume]]
**A man kills a 6-year-old [[Palestinian Americans|Palestinian]] [[Islam in the United States|Muslim]] boy and seriously injures his mother during a [[stabbing attack]] in [[Plainfield Township, Will County, Illinois|Plainfield Township]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]]. The perpetrator, who was the victims' [[landlord]], states he was motivated by the ongoing Israel–Gaza war. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/illinois-man-charged-with-hate-crime-fatal-stabbing-muslim-boy-2023-10-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]]n attacks across [[Ukraine]] over a 24-hour period kill at least six people, including two [[civilian]]s in [[Kherson]], which was bombarded with over 100 [[shell (projectile)|shells]] by [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]]. In a separate incident, a 14-year-old boy is killed by a [[land mine]] in [[Mykolaiv Oblast]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-deaths-shelling-drone-strike-b5a1d29456f9c2057724ad9ee54c830b (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Herat earthquakes]]
**Another [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude]] 6.3 [[list of earthquakes in Afghanistan|earthquake]] strikes [[Herat Province]], [[Afghanistan]], killing four people and injuring more than 150 others, several days after a series of powerful [[earthquake]]s killed over 1,000 people in the province. [https://www.itv.com/watch/news/four-people-killed-and-over-150-injured-after-afghanistan-hit-by-63-magnitude-earthquake/nld7jj5 (ITV)]
*At least 47 people are killed and dozens more are missing after a boat capsizes in [[Province of Équateur]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2023/10/17/47-bodies-recovered-in-congo-river-disaster/ (Africa News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Afghanistan–China relations]]
**The [[Taliban]] [[Government of Afghanistan|government]] confirms that it will attend the [[Belt and Road Initiative]] forum in [[Beijing]], [[China]], next week, as the countries form closer economic ties, including the potential construction of a large [[copper extraction|copper mine]] in [[Logar Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-join-chinas-belt-road-forum-elevating-ties-2023-10-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
****The heads of the [[Arab League]] and the [[African Union]] release a joint statement stating that Israel's planned ground invasion of Gaza "could lead to a [[genocide]] of unprecedented proportions". [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2391731/middle-east (AFP via Arab News)]
****[[President of Egypt|Egyptian President]] [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]] says that Israel's reaction to Hamas's attack "went beyond [[self-defence]] and amounted to [[collective punishment]]". [https://www.reuters.com/article/israel-palestinians-egypt-usa-idAFS8N39M02L (Reuters)]
***[[Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolas Maduro]] announces the provision of 30 tonnes of [[humanitarian aid]] to Gaza. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuelas-maduro-speaks-abbas-condemns-israels-actions-2023-10-15/ (Reuters)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
***Thousands of people attend rallies in support of [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] in several [[Australia|Australian]] cities. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-10-15/pro-palestinian-rallies-melbourne-sydney-adelaide/102966898 (ABC News Australia)]
***In the [[United Kingdom]], rallies take place in [[Manchester]] in [[Northern England]], [[Edinburgh]] and [[Glasgow]] in [[Scotland]], and [[London]], amid police warnings that support for [[Hamas]] could result in arrest. [https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2023/10/15/palestinian-support-demonstrations-around-the-world (Al Jazeera)]
***Protesters in [[Amsterdam]] call on the [[EU]] to take a stand against Israel's bombardment of Gaza, condemning European leaders for their silence on the violence Israel is committing in Gaza. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/14/israel-hamas-war-live-us-moves-second-aircraft-carrier-to-mediterranean (Al Jazeera)]
***Thousands of people attend rallies in support of [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231015-thousands-take-part-in-pro-palestinian-rally-in-turkey (France 24)]
**Lawyers and [[human rights]] organisations in Israel receive dozens of complaints from Palestinian workers and students who have been suspended from schools, universities and workplaces over [[social media]] posts or conversations with colleagues. [https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2023/10/15/from-friend-to-enemy-palestinians-in-israel-suspended-from-jobs-over-war (Al Jazeera)]
*A man is killed and other is wounded in [[stabbing as a terrorist tactic|stabbing attacks]] in [[Hartlepool]], [[County Durham]], [[England]]. The attacks are being investigated by [[Counter Terrorism Policing]]. [[Cleveland Police|Police]] arrest a [[Moroccans in the United Kingdom|Moroccan]] [[asylum seeker]] nearby. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-tees-67120165 (BBC News)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/hartlepool-terror-police-stabbing-death-b2430152.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Ecuadorian general election]]
**[[Ecuadorians]] vote in the [[Two-round system|second round]] of the presidential election between [[Luisa González]] and [[Daniel Noboa]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/14/ecuador-presidential-election-violence-crime (''The Guardian'')]
**The [[National Electoral Council (Ecuador)|National Electoral Council]] declares Noboa as [[President of Ecuador|president-elect]] with González conceding defeat. Noboa is [[Ecuador]]'s youngest president-elect. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231015-amid-escalating-drug-war-ecuadorans-elect-a-new-president (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2023 Polish parliamentary election]], [[2023 Polish referendum]]
**[[Polish people|Poles]] elect members of the [[Senate of Poland|Senate]] and the [[Sejm]]. Votes are also cast in a [[2023 Polish referendum|referendum]] on migration, the removal of the border wall between [[Belarus–Poland border barrier|Belarus and Poland]], and the retirement age. [https://www.barrons.com/news/polling-stations-open-for-polish-elections-afp-5e9c5b7b (AFP via ''Barron's'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/14/poland-election-race-too-close-to-call-as-voters-prepare-to-go-to-polls (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Exit poll]]s suggest that [[Poland]]'s [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] parties, led by the [[Civic Coalition (Poland)|Civic Coalition]] under former [[Prime Minister of Poland|prime minister]] [[Donald Tusk]], are poised to secure a [[parliamentary majority]], potentially ending the eight-year governance of the [[Law and Justice (Poland)|Law and Justice]] (PiS) party. The exit poll voter turnout reaches a record of 73%. [https://mb.com.ph/2023/10/15/polish-liberal-opposition-favoured-in-election-exit-poll (AFP via ''Manila Bulletin'')] [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/10/15/europe/poland-election-voting-intl/index.html (CNN)]
